scope: Fixed-view independent anvil tapping cycle only. Visual loop approval; task playback remains once-hold. Does not approve other forge actions, hidden geometry, walking, or all-direction contacts.

checks.identity-and-scale: Reviewed all eight layered poses: same head, beard, apron, camera and body scale; no direction change.
checks.station-and-foot-contact: Independent anvil stays fixed. Visible supporting boot stays on the same ground plane. Far foot is occluded by the station and is not separately certified.
checks.hand-and-tool-contact: Both hands retain their hammer/tong grips through lift, tap and rebound; source-bound projected billet measurement stays within 0.233 pixels of the working face.
checks.prop-continuity: Same separate anvil/stump throughout; hammer, tongs and billet remain present, with no workpiece exchange or completion-state reset.
checks.last-to-first-transition: Frame 7 returns the hammer to the billet at the contact pose used by frame 0. Reviewed all layered keyframes and repeat/seam playback; no material reset at the seam.
